name: Coconut Chicken Tenders with Thai Dipping Sauce & Cabbage-Mango Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Place bread crumbs, coconut, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the breading mixture and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ cup shredded unsweetened coconut
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and salt in a large bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice lengthwise into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo and toss to coat.
Add the breading mixture to the bowl with the chicken and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Divide chicken between the baking sheets and arrange in a single layer.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, about 18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
3 mangoes

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small saucepan along with honey, vinegar, water, and crushed red pepper. Set over medium-high heat and bring sauce to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ cup honey
½ cup rice vinegar
½ cup water
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce is boiling, reduce to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat, then transfer ⅓ of the sauce to a clean large bowl. Set remaining sauce aside for serving.
Juice limes into the bowl with the sauce, then whisk to combine the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; slice into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Divide chicken and salad between plates. Serve with reserved sauce for dipping and enjoy!
